newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Cesp still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Cesp still a buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said in a report it was maintaining its buy rating on Sao Paulo state power company Cesp.

-- "Our buy recommendation is based on the company's appreciation potential due to its determination to lower its debt, as well as to lower interest rates. This should be reflected in better results in the current year," said analyst Teresinha Moniz.
-- Cesp is Brazil's second largest hydroelectric power generator, accounting for 19 percent of the country's total power generation, she said.
-- The company plans to privatize in the second half of the year stakes in power distributor CPFL and natural gas firm Comgas, she added.
-- Cesp's preferred shares were trading at 54.20 reais, up 1.88 percent.
